full_name: Samantha Power | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Law Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow Harvard University
bio: Samantha Power is a professor of practice at Harvard Law School and the Anna Lindh Professor of the Practice of Global Leadership and Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School, where she was the founding executive director of the Carr Center for Human Rights Policy. She is a former US permanent representative to the United Nations and a former member of President Obama’s cabinet.
